title: Blinkist – The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People

items.meaning: 角落辦公室（象徵高階職位、事業成功）
items.usage: 名詞片語；大樓角落、有兩面窗的辦公室通常給高層主管，所以常用來比喻「升到高位」。常見：land / get a corner office。
items.example: She worked her way up from intern to a corner office in just ten years.
items.trans: 她只花十年就從實習生一路升到高階主管。

items.usage: a sense of + 抽象名詞是高頻搭配：a sense of achievement / purpose / belonging。形容詞常用 deep、real、great。動詞搭配：give sb / feel a sense of accomplishment。
items.example: Finishing the marathon gave me a real sense of accomplishment.
items.trans: 跑完馬拉松讓我很有成就感。

items.usage: 不及物動詞，後接 to + 名詞或原形動詞；比 want 正式，帶「有抱負」的語氣。文中 goals to which we aspire ＝ goals we aspire to（見 #18）。名詞 aspiration、形容詞 aspiring（aspiring writer 有志成為作家的人）。
items.example: Many junior engineers aspire to lead their own teams one day.
items.trans: 許多資淺工程師都渴望有朝一日能帶領自己的團隊。

items.meaning: 目標超出自己能力所及；心有餘而力不足
items.usage: 改寫自諺語 a man's reach should exceed his grasp（人的志向應超越能力所及，Robert Browning 詩句）。grasp 在此是「能掌握的範圍」。原諺語是正面鼓勵，文中則表示挫折感。
items.example: Early in my career, I often felt my ambitions exceeded my grasp.
items.trans: 職涯初期，我常覺得自己的抱負超出能力所及。

items.usage: tap into ＝ 開發、利用（原意是在桶上開孔取用）。常見受詞：potential、talent、a market、resources、emotions。近義 unlock / unleash one's potential。
items.example: Good managers know how to tap into their team's hidden potential.
items.trans: 好的主管懂得發掘團隊潛藏的潛力。

items.usage: 放句首或句中，引出出乎意料或回答前文疑問的事實。文中接在 If only there were a way…! 之後，回答「還真的有」。近義 as it happens。
items.example: I thought the meeting was cancelled, but as it turns out, it was just moved to Friday.
items.trans: 我以為會議取消了，結果只是改到星期五。

items.meaning: 充分利用、發揮最大價值
items.usage: get the most out of + 人／物／經驗。也可說 make the most of（make the most of 多接機會、時間）。用於自己時：get the most out of yourself ＝ 發揮自己最大的能力。
items.example: To get the most out of this course, do the exercises after each lesson.
items.trans: 想從這門課獲得最大收穫，每堂課後都要做練習。

items.usage: 常見於簡報、教學：take you through the details / the process。近義 walk sb through（更口語）。
items.example: Let me take you through the key figures from last quarter.
items.trans: 讓我帶大家看一下上一季的關鍵數據。

items.usage: 接在最高級後：the best / most influential … of all time。GOAT ＝ greatest of all time。
items.example: Many critics call it one of the greatest films of all time.
items.trans: 許多影評人稱它為有史以來最偉大的電影之一。

items.term: be on top of the best-seller lists
items.usage: 也可說 top the best-seller lists（top 當動詞）。注意 be on top of sth 另有「掌控、跟上進度」之意（stay on top of my emails），需靠上下文判斷。
items.example: Her debut novel has been on top of the best-seller lists for months.
items.trans: 她的處女作已經在暢銷榜上名列前茅好幾個月了。

items.usage: take charge of + 事物／局面／人生。強調主動接手、掌控；比較 be in charge of 是「負責（的狀態）」。與 #15 cultivate 同屬本書核心：主動經營自己的生活。
items.example: After the manager left, Lisa took charge of the project.
items.trans: 經理離職後，Lisa 接手負責這個專案。

items.usage: 常見：highly / deeply influential、an influential figure / book / thinker。動詞、名詞為 influence。重音在 -en-。
items.example: He is one of the most influential voices in the tech industry.
items.trans: 他是科技業最有影響力的聲音之一。

items.meaning: 有洞察力的、見解深刻的
items.usage: 形容意見、分析、評論或人：insightful advice / comments / analysis。名詞 insight（gain insight into…）。常用於稱讚會議發言：That's very insightful.
items.example: Thanks for your insightful feedback on the proposal.
items.trans: 謝謝你對提案提出深具見解的意見。

items.meaning: 有啟發性的、有教育意義的
items.usage: 多形容例子、經驗、比較：an instructive example / experience。易混淆 instructional（教學用的，如 instructional video），instructive 強調「讓人學到東西」。
items.example: It's instructive to compare how the two companies handled the crisis.
items.trans: 比較這兩家公司如何處理危機，很有啟發性。

items.meaning: 培養、養成（習慣、關係、形象）
items.usage: 原意「耕種」，引申為長期用心經營：cultivate a habit / a lifestyle / relationships / an image。比 develop 更有「慢慢培養」的感覺。與 #11 搭配使用。
items.example: She has cultivated strong relationships with key clients over the years.
items.trans: 多年來她和重要客戶培養出深厚的關係。

items.usage: 最常見 a self-help book / guide / guru。書店分類常寫 Self-Help。有時帶輕微貶意，暗指內容空泛。
items.example: I used to be skeptical of self-help books, but this one changed my mind.
items.trans: 我以前對自我成長書很存疑，但這本改變了我的看法。

items.term: If only there were a way to…!
items.usage: If only + 假設語氣（過去式，be 動詞用 were）表達強烈願望。文章常先用這句製造渴望，再用 Well, as it turns out, there is.（#6）揭曉答案，是很好用的開場手法。
items.example: If only there were a way to finish all these reports before Friday!
items.trans: 要是有辦法在星期五前把這些報告全做完就好了！

items.term: N + to which + S + V（goals to which we aspire）
items.meaning: 介係詞移到關係代名詞前的正式寫法
items.usage: goals to which we aspire ＝ goals (that) we aspire to。介係詞前移讓語氣更正式，適合書面、簡報；口語通常把介係詞留在句尾。類似：the project on which I worked / the people with whom we partner。
items.example: These are the standards to which every team member should be held.
items.trans: 這些是每位團隊成員都應遵守的標準。

items.term: To get the most out of X, you just need to…
items.usage: 不定詞片語放句首表目的，再用 just need to 把方法說得簡單易行，常見於建議、教學、行銷文案。可換成 To succeed in…, you just need to…
items.example: To get the most out of your new phone, you just need to update a few settings.
items.trans: 想讓新手機發揮最大效能，你只需要調整幾項設定。

items.term: …, and there is a very good reason for this.
items.usage: 先陳述現象，再用這句預告接下來要解釋原因，引起讀者好奇。簡報中也好用：Sales doubled last quarter, and there's a very good reason for this.
items.example: Our customer retention is the highest in the industry, and there is a very good reason for this.
items.trans: 我們的顧客留存率是業界最高，而這背後有很充分的理由。

items.usage: find one's way around + 地方＝熟悉環境、會認路；find one's way to＝找到去某處的路。也可比喻摸清新工作、新系統。
items.example: It took me a week to find my way around the new office.
items.trans: 我花了一週才摸熟新辦公室的環境。

items.usage: 反義 in the long term / in the long run。也可當形容詞 short-term（short-term goals）。常用來對比短期與長期效果。
items.example: Cutting prices may boost sales in the short term, but it hurts our brand.
items.trans: 降價短期內也許能提升銷售，但會傷害品牌。

items.usage: 表示非預期或不理想的結果：end up lost / end up working late / end up in hospital。
items.example: We missed the last train and ended up taking a taxi home.
items.trans: 我們錯過末班車，最後只好搭計程車回家。

items.usage: grasp 當動詞＝透徹理解，比 understand 更有「抓住要點」的感覺：grasp the concept / the importance of。名詞用法見 #4。
items.example: Once you grasp the basic principles, the rest is easy.
items.trans: 一旦掌握基本原則，其他就簡單了。

items.usage: make a habit of + V-ing；否定常說 I don't make a habit of it（我不常這樣）。近義 get into the habit of。
items.example: I've made a habit of reviewing my notes every morning.
items.trans: 我養成每天早上複習筆記的習慣。

items.usage: 回顧過去的時間、經歷；look back on 多帶感情或反思。In looking back, …＝回頭看。
items.example: Looking back on my first job, I learned a lot from my mistakes.
items.trans: 回顧第一份工作，我從錯誤中學到很多。

items.meaning: 帶來（根本的）改變、有重大影響
items.usage: make a difference＝有影響、有差別；可加 big / real / huge / fundamental。make a difference to sth＝對某事有影響。與 #37 superficial 對比。
items.example: A short daily walk can make a real difference to your health.
items.trans: 每天短暫散步對健康有很大的幫助。

items.meaning: 使 A 與 B 一致、對齊
items.usage: 職場超常用：align our goals with the company strategy；be aligned with＝與……一致。名詞 alignment（in alignment with）。
items.example: We need to align our marketing plan with the sales targets.
items.trans: 我們需要讓行銷計畫與業績目標一致。

items.usage: lasting＝持久的：a lasting impression / impact / peace。近義 long-lasting、enduring；反義 short-lived、temporary。
items.example: Crash diets rarely achieve lasting results.
items.trans: 速成節食很少能帶來持久的效果。

items.usage: 與 in theory 對比：In theory it works, but in practice…。put sth into practice＝付諸實行。
items.example: The policy sounds simple, but in practice it's hard to enforce.
items.trans: 這項政策聽起來簡單，但實際上很難執行。

items.usage: work on sth＝努力改進某事（work on my English / my presentation skills）。work on yourself 強調從內在改變，呼應本段的 Character Ethic。
items.example: Before blaming others, try working on yourself first.
items.trans: 在責怪別人之前，先試著改善自己。

items.usage: 常獨立成句：That's easier said than done. 或放句中：Of course, this is easier said than done.
items.example: Just stop worrying? That's easier said than done.
items.trans: 別擔心就好？說得容易做起來難。

items.usage: 用來總結前文；近義 in a word、to sum up、in a nutshell（口語）。
items.example: In short, we need more time and a bigger budget.
items.trans: 簡單說，我們需要更多時間和更多預算。

items.usage: 強調不貪多、按部就班。相關 one step at a time（一步一步來）、one by one。
items.example: Let's tackle these problems one at a time.
items.trans: 我們一個一個處理這些問題吧。

items.usage: 正式用語，指看待事物的基本模式；a paradigm shift＝典範轉移、根本性的觀念改變（商業文章常見）。g 不發音。
items.example: Remote work has caused a paradigm shift in how companies hire.
items.trans: 遠距工作讓企業招聘方式出現根本性的轉變。

items.usage: 單數 ethic 指一套價值觀，常見 work ethic（職業道德、敬業精神）；複數 ethics＝倫理學、道德規範。形容詞 ethical。
items.example: She's known for her strong work ethic.
items.trans: 她以敬業精神著稱。

items.usage: 形容改變、傷口、了解、人：superficial changes / knowledge / wounds。反義 fundamental（#27）、deep、profound。
items.example: The redesign was purely superficial; the app still crashes.
items.trans: 這次改版純粹是表面功夫，App 還是會當機。

items.usage: 只放名詞前：underlying cause / problem / principle / assumption。常用於分析問題根源。
items.example: We need to address the underlying cause, not just the symptoms.
items.trans: 我們要處理根本原因，而不只是表面症狀。

items.usage: have / show / feel empathy for sb；形容詞 empathetic / empathic。易混淆 sympathy（同情）：empathy 是能設身處地感受。
items.example: Good leaders show empathy for their team members.
items.trans: 好的領導者對團隊成員展現同理心。

items.usage: perceive A as B＝把 A 視為 B；be perceived as＝被認為是。名詞 perception（public perception 大眾觀感）。比 see 正式。
items.example: Customers perceive our brand as reliable but expensive.
items.trans: 顧客認為我們的品牌可靠但昂貴。

items.usage: 用情境＋提問開場，讓讀者代入，再引出主題。簡報、文章開頭很好用；後面常接 Well, … 給答案（同 #6、#17 的手法）。
items.example: Imagine you're starting a new job tomorrow. How will you make a good first impression?
items.trans: 想像你明天要開始新工作，你會怎麼留下好的第一印象？

items.term: While X can be useful, it's far more valuable to…
items.meaning: 雖然 X 有用，但……更有價值
items.usage: While 表讓步，先承認一方再強調另一方；far 加強比較級。適合提建議、做比較。
items.example: While online courses can be useful, it's far more valuable to practice with real clients.
items.trans: 雖然線上課程有幫助，但和真實客戶實際練習更有價值。

items.term: become the kind of person who…
items.usage: 把目標從「做某事」轉為「成為某種人」，是本書核心觀念（呼應 #31）。the kind of + N + who / that…
items.example: If you want to be trusted, become the kind of person who keeps promises.
items.trans: 想被信任，就成為那種說到做到的人。

items.term: X requires that + S + (should) V原形
items.usage: require、suggest、insist、recommend 後接 that 子句時，動詞用原形（假設語氣）：requires that you cultivate（不是 cultivates）。正式書面常見。
items.example: The new policy requires that every employee complete the training by May.
items.trans: 新政策要求每位員工在五月前完成訓練。
